context_generation.context_id: first 16 lowercase hex characters of sha256(canonical_json UTF-8)
context_generation.rounding: Store generated floating parameters rounded to 12 decimal places before canonicalization.

purpose: Complete deterministic generative manifest for matched-call provenance rollback router comparison. It supersedes the earlier partial enumerated form at the same path.

router_protocol.cost_model: linear regression on train runs using fanout, depth, static_fp, independent_ratio, r_observed, r_static
router_protocol.fixed_allocation_comparison: also rank test contexts by each router score and compare at equal union-routing fractions {0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.30}
router_protocol.success_calibration: separate logistic regression on train runs for each feature
router_protocol.threshold_tuning: train only; maximize correct endpoints per 100k calls subject to train endpoint failure <= 1%

simulation.affected_graph: rooted full fanout-ary tree of specified depth downstream of one corrected source datum
simulation.critical_endpoint: one deterministic random root-to-leaf path per run; union rollback succeeds iff every true edge on that path is union-captured
simulation.observed_capture: each true dependency edge independently captured with probability r_observed
simulation.run_seed: uint64(first 16 hex of sha256(context_id + '|' + run_index)) mod (2^63-1)
simulation.static_capture: conditional on observed capture, captured with probability p_static_given_observed_hit; conditional on observed miss, with q_static_given_observed_miss
simulation.static_false_positive_capture: each independent node included in union replay with probability static_fp
simulation.union_recovery_calls: 1 source replacement + union-reachable affected nodes + static-false-positive independent nodes
simulation.whole_redraw_calls: 1 source replacement + all affected nodes + all independent nodes
simulation.whole_redraw_endpoint_success: 1.0 conditional on the same source replacement being correct

split_rule.test: all remaining contexts; deliberately holds out fanout/depth=4 and overlap extremes 0.10/0.90
split_rule.train: fanout in {2,3} AND depth in {2,3} AND overlap_u in {0.35,0.65}
